adopted.root_adoption_note: Separate reviews agree; provisionally adopted after root evidence checks.

primary.evidence: Orders 2 and 3 both show a broad native feature and diffuse trace-centered excess across several dispersion rows. The feature is photon-compatible but its origin remains unresolved.

secondary.evidence: Both o2 and o3 show a broad rounded native feature with smooth trace-centered multi-row excess. This is broader spectral/photon-like structure of unresolved origin.

comparison.root_note: Separate reviews agree; provisionally adopted after root evidence checks.

historical_review_note: Exact original primary/secondary/adopted U/U/U remains for0260. Two broad native features and diffuse trace-centered multi-row excess remain unresolved. Orders2/3 retain original global support, local/baseline failures and later five-window support as distinct stages. Use own April27 2025 discovery and six existing HD126093 observations; no HD114783 scope or quality is transferred. No observational array value is interpreted during restoration.
full_raw_note: Original raw products remain available in the same verified discovery archives; this broader-profile phase restores native A and existing raw cutouts only.
